newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank refinancing loans slip in April.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank refinancing loans slip in April.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) refinancing loans dropped by 12.6 percent in April after a 4.6 percent fall in March on the back of a sharp decline in auctioned credits, BNR data showed on Wednesday.
Total average daily refinancing was 5.1 trillion lei in April, when auctioned credits went down to 168.5 billion lei from 530.3 billion the previous month.
The BNR eventually gave up refinancing credit auctions late in April, pledging to implement open-market operations to conduct its monetary policy.

Lombard loans slipped to 13.2 billion lei from 32.6 billion in March on a money market fairly overliquid in the leu after the BNR had soaked excess dollars in order to prevent the local currency from firming.
Structural refinancing facilities, for which the BNR charges a discount rate of 50 percent, rose to 2.6 trillion lei from 2.2 trillion the previous month.

Credits granted to debtors in dispute at law, respectively to troubled banks Dacia Felix SA and Renasterea Creditului Romanesc Credit Bank SA, were frozen at 1.87 trillion lei. The BNR does not charge interest on loans to those debtors.
Both banks, which revealed big debts and huge losses, await court rulings on their reorganisation or liquidation. ($=7,097 lei)
